summary: Tarfin is the name and chest (front) sponsor - the men's team plays as 'Fenerbahce Tarfin' in 2026/27 and 2027/28. Astor Enerji is the second front sponsor (forma onu). MSC and RAMS Global sit on the back (RAMS below the back number in BSL games, front under the chest logo in EuroLeague games). Milk Academy is the arm (sleeve) sponsor, EN-EZ Insaat the shorts-side sponsor, YKT Filo the other arm-side sponsor, and adidas the kit maker.
